groups.rationale: Reviewed ADR-0233: chapter 22 now places salopettes on fleet0 (10.90.0.3, IPv6 off, peering only with Overalls), routes Marshall to Susan over the tunnel with its failure boundary, and names the shared fleet-addresses document; the generated deployment view reflects the third peer; chapters 01, 17 and 21 need no change.

Reviewed: shared HLDD pages (deployment, operations, options, coverage, security, topology) and scenarios fleet-addresses-from-sops and hcloud-susan-host changed for ADR-0233; Marshall application code is unchanged and its wildcard nameserver runtime credential is a NixOS module change covered by the deployment group. Also covers the upstream Underclass dbaf7b8 pin (overload-failover scenario, services chapter and option default), reviewed with that change.

Reviewed: no protocol code or fixtures changed; only shared generated HLDD pages and scenarios changed for ADR-0233 fleet addresses. Also covers the upstream Underclass dbaf7b8 pin (overload-failover scenario, services chapter and option default), reviewed with that change.

Reviewed: no Lilly application code changed; runtime protected addresses are a NixOS module and updater change recorded in the deployment group and chapter 20, and Lilly's network claim is unchanged because the effective protected set is compared. Also covers the upstream Underclass dbaf7b8 pin (overload-failover scenario, services chapter and option default), reviewed with that change.

Reviewed: audi/test/config_test.exs only replaces a fleet address literal with a documentation address; Audi, Porsche and Audi DNS runtime binds are NixOS module changes recorded in the deployment group; no service behavior changed. Also covers the upstream Underclass dbaf7b8 pin (overload-failover scenario, services chapter and option default), reviewed with that change.

Reviewed ADR-0233: chapter 13 documents overalls.fleetAddresses, the runtime uplink and recovery copy, the runtime firewall chain on both backends, runtime WireGuard endpoints and service binds; chapter 20 adds fleet address custody and the Susan fleet path; chapter 14 names addresses by secret; options reference, coverage, scenarios fleet-addresses-from-sops and hcloud-susan-host, and the tests README updated. Also covers the upstream Underclass dbaf7b8 pin (overload-failover scenario, services chapter and option default), reviewed with that change.

Reviewed ADR-0233 with ADR-0232 superseded and reciprocal amendments in ADR-0075, 0091 and 0231, the ADR index, the 2026-10-20 review, the secrets README fleet addresses section, the fleet network and egress acceptance runbooks, address literals in ADRs and reviews replaced by secret names, and the egress runner reading the protected address from its private run directory. Also covers the upstream Underclass dbaf7b8 pin (overload-failover scenario, services chapter and option default), reviewed with that change.
